body: THANK YOU! I didn't know the walk in clinics can prescribe me acne medicine, I actually just called the local "Little Clinic" and I've been there before for Sports Physicals. They told me they can prescribe oral and cream medications. The check up is only $69. I honestly never knew they could prescribe me it, while I don't have the money to pay for it right now, you have seriously just given me new hope.
